chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
“If you forget something from the salat (prayer), whether bowing, prostration, or takbir, then remember it, make up what you missed due to forgetfulness.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual salat (prayer) in which the omission occurred
key_terms.تَكْبِيرًا: the utterance of takbir within salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَاقْضِ: make up or perform what was missed

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forget a part of the prayer and then remember it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about forgetfulness in salat (prayer). It instructs that when a person remembers an omitted part such as rukuʿ, sujud, or takbir, he should make up what he missed due to forgetfulness.
